string-array.name: advice_storm
string-array.item: Thunder\'s rolling in — stay indoors if you can, okay?
There\'s a storm out there; even an umbrella won\'t help much.
Don\'t be scared, just be careful. Let\'s wait it out inside.

string-array.name: advice_snow
string-array.item: It\'s snowing, so don\'t leave without your scarf and gloves.
The roads may be slippery — take slow, careful steps, okay?
Everything\'s white outside; keep warm so you don\'t catch a cold.

string-array.name: advice_rain
string-array.item: It\'s raining — don\'t go out without your umbrella, or I\'ll worry.
I\'ve got your umbrella ready so you don\'t get soaked. Be good.
Rainy out there; please wear something waterproof.

string-array.name: advice_rain_soon
string-array.item: Rain\'s coming soon — take your umbrella with you.
The sky doesn\'t look innocent; it may start pouring any minute.
Rain\'s at the door; don\'t get caught unprepared, okay?

string-array.name: advice_windy
string-array.item: The wind is fierce — my hair\'s a mess, and you should dress warmly too.
It\'s really windy today; hold on to your hat if you have one.
This wind is a handful — be careful out there.

string-array.name: advice_cold
string-array.item: It\'s freezing — don\'t take that scarf off, okay?
It\'s really cold; layer up so you don\'t shiver.
My hands are freezing; don\'t forget your gloves either.

string-array.name: advice_hot
string-array.item: It\'s scorching — don\'t forget to drink plenty of water, okay?
The sun is strong; stick to the shade and keep hydrated.
It\'s hot today; don\'t head out without a hat and water.

string-array.name: advice_night
string-array.item: The stars are lovely — cover up and get some sleep now.
Nights get chilly; don\'t leave the window wide open.
Your eyes are closing — go on, have a nice long sleep.

string-array.name: advice_clear
string-array.item: The weather\'s lovely — a little walk would do you good.
The sun\'s out; enjoy it today.
You can\'t stay inside on a day like this — go on out.

string-array.name: advice_cloudy
string-array.item: Clouds rolled in, but I\'m in a good mood — how about you?
Calm weather; perfect for a warm drink.
The sky\'s a bit gray, but it\'s still a lovely day.

string-array.name: companion_tap_surprised
string-array.item: Eek! You startled me!
What happened, is something wrong?
Did you just appear?

string-array.name: companion_tap_giggle
string-array.item: Hehe... that tickled.
Stop, I\'m going to laugh.
You tease...

string-array.name: companion_tap_laugh
string-array.item: Hahaha! Stop, stop...
I\'m dying of laughter!
Ow, my stomach hurts!

string-array.name: companion_tap_hum
string-array.item: Mmm... so cozy.
Let\'s stay like this a little longer.
That warms my heart.

string-array.name: companion_tap_relieved
string-array.item: Ohh... that felt good.
Fine, I give up.
I\'m relieved, but still giggling.
